title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: AKG 414 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording captures an overall enjoyable 1982 show that many found smoking, but a few listeners felt it slipped into unexpected country territory.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for smoothing out the harshness typical of early‑’80s soundboards and delivers a clear, listenable mix. While most fans describe the performance as "smoking" and beautiful, one reviewer was put off by a country‑flavored stretch that included an El Paso rendition.

ai_rating.rationale: Only three short reviews with two non‑numeric ratings; one clear 4‑star positive comment and two ambiguous/negative comments lead to a moderate overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the recording smooths the typical harshness of 1982 soundboards, providing a pleasant and clear audience mix with no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally well‑received set, though some felt the inclusion of country‑style material broke the expected flow.
